points.description: Euler tour is a walk around the tree starting at the root (traversing/going around the whole tree, e.g. along its edges).
points.partial_credit: Half if only a vague traversal of the tree is mentioned without the walk around the tree from the root, or with a minor error.

points.description: Each node is visited/seen three times: from the left, from below (in between), and from the right.
points.partial_credit: Half if says nodes are visited multiple times (or three times) without naming the left/below/right.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that the Euler tour is a walk around the tree starting at the root, in any wording; mentioning the three visits per node (left, below, right) earns the last mark. Part marks for a vague traversal description or saying nodes are visited several times without detail. No marks for describing only preorder, inorder or postorder, or unrelated ideas.
